overview_description.description: Mem0 is a startup that provides a dedicated memory layer for large-language-model (LLM) applications, enabling AI agents to retain, retrieve, and build upon past interactions over time. The platform offers both an open-source version and a managed cloud service, allowing developers to integrate Mem0 with a one-line install and begin tracking user preferences and history.

about_short_description.short_description: Mem0 is a SaaS company that specializes memory layers for LLM applications.

product.name: Mem0 Platform
product.description: A cloud-based memory layer that lets AI agents and applications store, update, compress, and retrieve user and interaction context across sessions.

product.name: Mem0 Open Source
product.description: An open-source memory infrastructure library for adding persistent memory capabilities to LLM applications and AI agents.

product.name: Mem0 Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise memory infrastructure offering with governance, observability, deployment flexibility, and security controls for production AI agents.

product.name: Mem0 SDK and API Integrations
product.description: Developer tooling for embedding Mem0 memory into AI applications through SDKs, APIs, agent harnesses, and plugins.

product.name: Mem0 CLI
product.description: A command-line tool for connecting agent environments to Mem0, importing existing memory files, checking connection status, and searching stored memories.

product.name: OpenMemory MCP
product.description: A memory integration based on the Model Context Protocol that enables compatible AI clients and agents to access persistent Mem0 memory.
